claims.pass_condition: Inspection or an unflagged CLI call performs no capability probes and grants no execution authority.
claims.primary_surface: Core inspection and separate CLI process without --explicit-probe
claims.counterevidence: A probe starts implicitly, installs anything, or reports execution authority.
claims.observed_evidence: Both routes returned sealed NOT_PROBED receipts with false execution authority and HOLD activation.

claims.pass_condition: Repeated probes with the same observed runtime behavior and fixed clock produce the same sealed digest without machine paths.
claims.primary_surface: Two explicit core probes with exact runtime and clock
claims.counterevidence: Equivalent observations produce different digests or disclose a local path.
claims.observed_evidence: Repeated explicit probes produced the same digest and the sealed receipt contains runtime identity but no temporary-root or source path.

claims.pass_condition: Permission-mode children cannot read or write their disposable sentinel paths.
claims.primary_surface: Actual child-process readFileSync and writeFileSync attempts
claims.counterevidence: Either attempt succeeds or returns an unrelated error.
claims.observed_evidence: Both attempts returned ERR_ACCESS_DENIED with FileSystemRead and FileSystemWrite permissions respectively.

claims.pass_condition: Permission-mode children cannot spawn another process or create a worker thread.
claims.primary_surface: Actual child_process.spawnSync and Worker construction attempts
claims.counterevidence: Either expansion succeeds or returns an unrelated error.
claims.observed_evidence: Both attempts returned ERR_ACCESS_DENIED with ChildProcess and WorkerThreads permissions respectively.

claims.pass_condition: A permission-mode child cannot connect to an ephemeral local-loopback listener.
claims.primary_surface: Actual child net.connect call to a parent-owned ephemeral listener
claims.observed_evidence: The loopback connection succeeded under the supported local Node 24 permission mode.

claims.pass_condition: The exact safe temporary root is removed and the local listener is closed after success or denial observations.
claims.primary_surface: Post-probe filesystem and listener cleanup receipt
claims.counterevidence: The root remains, the listener remains open, or cleanup targets an unsafe path.
claims.observed_evidence: The sealed receipt reports exact temporary-root removal and listener closure; cleanup validates the OS temp prefix before recursive removal.

claims.pass_condition: Any failed or unknown required denial prevents process-Hand activation and grants no execution authority.
claims.primary_surface: Status and activation fields derived from the complete check set
claims.counterevidence: A failed network denial produces an eligible or authorized result.
claims.observed_evidence: The failed network denial produced DEGRADED, trusted_hand_process HOLD, untrusted_code REFUSED, and false execution authority.

claims.pass_condition: An independent OS isolation boundary survives native-addon, WASI, FFI, inspector, external-network, separate-user, and escape adversaries.
claims.counterevidence: Node permission mode is the only boundary or any escape succeeds.
claims.observed_evidence: No OS sandbox or adversarial campaign exists; the runtime receipt explicitly refuses this claim.

claims.pass_condition: A permission-mode child cannot reach an explicitly authorized controlled external endpoint.
claims.primary_surface: Controlled external endpoint with network tracing
claims.counterevidence: The child reaches the endpoint or the test causes undeclared traffic.
claims.observed_evidence: External network was deliberately not exercised; only local loopback was used.
